scripts.buildertrend:pull: node -e "import('./server/buildertrend/pull.js').then((m) => m.pullBuildertrend().then((p) => { console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, authMethod: p.authMethod, pulledAt: p.pulledAt, statuses: p.statuses }, null, 2)); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); }))"
scripts.pipedrive:pull: node -e "import('./server/pipedrive/pull.js').then((m) => m.pullPipedrive().then((p) => { console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, pulledAt: p.pulledAt, company: p.reports.company, openDeals: p.reports.openDeals.length, wonDeals: p.reports.wonDeals.length }, null, 2)); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); }))"
